description: Produces the re-editable text for a cell — the value as the user would type it, rather than the formatted display. A formula returns its expression; a percentage returns e.g. 50%; a date/time returns its (re-parseable) formatted form; a number returns its canonical form without thousands separators. This is the inverse intent of .

members.name: GetEditText
members.description: Returns the editable text for using .
